title: 第8章 我重生了
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: 夏晚晴脸上的傻乐僵住。她眼睛瞪得溜圆，双手猛地交叉护在胸前，整个人往沙发角落里一缩。看叶凛的眼神像是在看一个刚越狱出来的变态“老……老叶？”她咽了口唾沫，嗓子发紧：“你受什么刺激了？”“刚才拒绝那个大胸校花……该不会是因为你看上我的美色了吧？！”“我们可是兄弟啊！”“兄弟就是兄弟，兄弟是不能做这种事情的啊！！”叶凛眼皮都没抬，视线在那件宽松T恤下平坦如机场的区域扫过。随后，他发出了一声极具侮辱性的鼻音。“呵。”伤害性不大，侮辱性极强。叶凛晃了晃手里的精油瓶，一脸嫌弃：“我是要给你推拿。”“就你这搓衣板身材，我怕咯着手。”“推拿？”夏晚晴愣了一下，随即炸毛。“叶凛你大爷！你说谁搓衣板呢！”“我也很有料的好不好！那是运动型内衣压的！压的懂不懂！”“不信你上手试试！”“行行行，压得好，压到马里亚纳海沟去了。”叶凛指了指那张单人床。“你都没我胸肌大呢就别计较这些了，趴好。”夏晚晴骂骂咧咧地挪过去，嘴里嘀咕着“要不是看你失恋我高低给你两拳”，身体却很诚实地趴在了床上。“真就是推拿？”她又不放心地回头确认。“不然呢？你又没付我额外的费用。”叶凛没再废话，拧开瓶盖。浓郁的玫瑰香气瞬间炸开，不腻人，反倒带着一股晨曦般的清冽。他倒出一点粉色液体在掌心，体温将其熨热。“老叶，你轻点啊，我这人怕痒……”“我知道，不痒的。”话音未落，叶凛的手掌毫无预兆地扣上了她的背阔肌。“嗷——！！！”一声惨绝人寰的嚎叫差点把楼板震穿。叶凛的大拇指像把精密的液压钳，精准切入肩胛骨缝隙。没有丝毫怜香惜玉的前戏，每一次发力，都精准地碾碎了深层肌肉的粘连点。“疼疼疼！断了！骨头要断了！”夏晚晴疼得想表演一个鲤鱼打挺。但背上那双手重如泰山，把她死死钉在床板上。全属性一千对上全属性一点，这是降维打击。“闭嘴，别乱动。”叶凛面无表情，手下动作不停。在他眼里，手底下按着的不是青梅竹马，甚至不是个女人，而是一块等待加工的璞玉。那瓶【晨曦玫瑰】接触皮肤的瞬间，就展现出了神造之物的霸道。原本只是淡粉色的油液，碰到夏晚晴那健康的小麦色肌肤，就像水渗进干海绵，“滋溜”一下就钻了进去。手感变了。前一秒还带着凡人肉体的粗糙和僵硬。下一秒，皮肤就像是在揉一块正在发酵的面团，越揉越韧，越揉越滑。就是很可惜，夏晚晴小麦色的皮肤并没有变白半分。“我不行了……叶凛你大爷的……你这是谋杀……”夏晚晴的声音带上了哭腔，在床上扭得像条蛆。叶凛充耳不闻，掌根抵住脊柱两侧的膀胱经，发力一推。咔哒——一声清脆的骨骼复位声。“啊——呼……”夏晚晴的惨叫戛然而止，取而代之的是一声带着颤音的舒爽叹息。痛到极致后，一股滚烫的热流顺着脊椎骨疯狂乱窜，爽得她头皮发麻。“别叫唤，留着力气吸收。”叶凛心里飞快计算着。这精油的效果比预想的还要离谱。仅仅推了几下，夏晚晴背部的肌肉线条就开始微调。原本因为长期送外卖和兼职而有些劳损的斜方肌变得更加紧实有力。甚至……叶凛视线扫过她被压在枕头下的侧脸，又顺势往下瞥了一眼。虽然趴着看不真切，但他敏锐地察觉到，这丫头的胸围似乎……长了？神力滋养是全方位的优化，连那点可怜的脂肪都在往该去的地方跑。“老叶……”夏晚晴缓过那阵劲儿，趴在枕头上像条死狗，声音软绵绵的。“你这手法……哪学的？”叶凛没搭理她，大拇指按上了她的腰眼。“嘶——”夏晚晴倒吸一口凉气。为了转移注意力，开始没话找话：“那个……你别不说话啊。”“虽然秦菲菲那个女人确实不是东西，但咱也不差。”“你看你，长得帅，还会……还会搓澡，以后肯定能找个更好的。”叶凛手指稳稳地在命门穴上打着圈，心里翻了个白眼。这丫头脑子里装的都是浆糊吗？他沉默是因为在专心引导药力。这精油每一滴都价值连城，要是浪费了，他真的会心疼到无法呼吸。见叶凛不说话，夏晚晴急了，努力把脑袋从枕头里拔出来一点，侧脸看他：“哎呀你别这么闷着！要不咱们聊聊那个神像？”“说真的，今天那个大铁块降临的时候，我感觉脑瓜子嗡嗡的，吵死了。”叶凛动作一顿，随即恢复正常，肘部压住她的大腿外侧：“吵？”“对啊，就市中心那个冒火的大家伙。”“隔着老远我就能听见他在喊。”夏晚晴此时也被按开了，说话利索了不少。“喊什么？”叶凛淡淡问道。他的手掌贴着夏晚晴的大腿肌肉向下游走，推散淤积的乳酸。“听不清……反正很暴躁，一直在骂街。”“什么‘该死的小白脸’、‘别让我抓到你’、‘我要把你锤成肉泥’之类的。”叶凛眼皮一跳。好家伙，这是赫菲斯托斯的精神广播？不像是假的。隔着这么远都能接收到，看样子应该是什么天赋的体现？“然后呢？祂没给你什么？”叶凛手上加了把劲。“啊！疼！轻点！”夏晚晴疼得呲牙咧嘴。“新闻上不是说了吗，要想获得力量，得呼唤神明的【真名】和【事迹】。”“可谁知道那个瘸腿的大块头叫什么？”“长得那么丑，腿一长一短的，手里还拿个锤子，难道是装修之神？”“反正是外国人唤醒的祂，估计传到咱们这儿还需要点时间。”叶凛差点没绷住笑出声。要是让那铁匠听到，估计能气得当场把蓝星给炼了。“现在网上都吵翻天了。”夏晚晴趴在那任由摆布，嘴却没停。“专家说咱们这边的神话好像断层了，还有恒水国啊，玛雅国那些，都断了。”“大家都知道有神仙，但具体叫什么、干过什么事，没有记载。”“反倒是国外那些乱七八糟的神，好像还有点零星的记载。”“这不公平啊老叶！”她有些愤愤不平。“凭什么咱们就要给洋神仙当狗？”“我就不信咱们华夏没有比那个装修工更厉害的神！”“神力亲和度怎么测？”叶凛突然问了个关键问题。既然夏晚晴能感应到神像，那说明官方或者民间应该已经有了初步的检测手段。“不知道啊。”“那个秦菲菲估计是那帮有钱人搞出来的内部测试。”说到这，她突然想起了什么，声音变得兴奋：“不过老叶，我感觉我现在强得可怕！真的！你这精油神了！”“我现在感觉体内有一团火在烧，刚才我想翻身的时候，差点把你这床板给捏碎了！”叶凛低头看了一眼。确实。原本有些松垮的床单，被她抓在手里的那一部分，已经出现了明显的裂纹。“别乱动。”叶凛一巴掌拍在她紧绷的臀大肌上，“还没按完。”“哦……”夏晚晴瞬间老实了，脸埋在枕头里，耳根子红透了。这一巴掌……打得有点顺手啊。空气再次陷入沉默，只有叶凛的手指在皮肤上摩擦发出的沙沙声。这种沉默让夏晚晴心里更慌了，她觉得叶凛这是在强颜欢笑。明明被甩了，还要装作若无其事地给自已推拿，甚至拿出了这么珍贵的精油……这精油一看就不便宜，效果那么好，他一定是把所有的积蓄都花在这上面了。太惨了。没钱，没工作，没女朋友，现在连最后的家底都给自已用了。夏晚晴有些母爱泛滥了。作为从小罩着他的好兄弟，这时候如果不拉他一把，自已还算个人吗？“那个……老叶。”夏晚晴的声音从枕头里闷闷地传出来。“嗯？”叶凛正在处理她小腿上的经络，这里的肌肉线条已经变得极其完美，修长、紧致。“你现在……是不是没钱付房租了？”叶凛手一顿。钱？他兜里躺着三万现金，付个房租绰绰有余。还没等他开口，夏晚晴就自顾自地接了下去：“咱们知根知底的，谁不知道谁啊。”“我那房子虽然小了点，但也是两室一厅。”“房东那老太太挺喜欢我的，房租也没涨。”“要不……你搬过来跟我一起住吧？”叶凛一愣。合租？“你别多想啊！”夏晚晴似乎怕他误会，语速飞快。“我是看你现在这状态……怕你一个人想不开。”“而且……而且咱们合租还能省一半房租呢！”“这年头赚钱多难啊，能省一点是一点。”说到最后，她的声音越来越小。虽然理由找得冠冕堂皇，但刚才叶凛那句“把衣服脱了”，现在还在她脑子里回荡。叶凛没管她那红得快要滴血的耳垂，心里在飞快盘算这笔买卖的性价比。首先，省钱。其次，夏晚晴有这瓶神油的强化，这丫头现在的战斗力绝对不容小觑。在这个混乱的初期，身边有个绝对忠诚且能打的保镖，安全性直线上升。最重要的是……这丫头做饭挺好吃的。“可以。”叶凛的手依旧没有离开她的背，掌心贴着温热的肌肤。“房租我出三分之二，水电全包。”“但我有个条件。”“啊？”夏晚晴愣了一下，显然没想到他答应得这么干脆，“什么条件？”“不用你多出钱，一人一半就行……”“你做饭。”叶凛打断了她。夏晚晴：“……”就这？她刚想吐槽两句，突然——咚咚咚！！！一阵急促的砸门声响起。……“我重生了？”苏沐雪盯着手机屏幕上显示的日期，那股不真实感像潮水一样退去。上一世，神话复苏，全民觉醒。她因为没有神力亲和度，只是个被保护的普通人。在一次魔兽潮中，她像蝼蚁一样被路过的巨兽踩成了肉泥。而那个在学校里大大咧咧，像个假小子的夏晚晴，却成了华夏唯一的救世主。齐天大圣，孙悟空的代行者。一根金箍棒，打杀近百代行者。那个身披金甲圣衣的身影，是苏沐雪上一世临死前看到的最后一道光。“既然老天让我重活一次，我就绝不能再当蝼蚁。”上一世的记忆里，夏晚晴之所以能唤醒那尊石猴，是因为她一口气喊出了八十多项孙悟空的事迹。在这个神话断层的世界，这根本是不可能的事情。除非……夏晚晴身上有秘密。或许是一本古籍，或许是一件传家宝。不管是什么，只要知道这是未来的大佬就行了。到时候人家随便从手指缝里掉一点出来就够自已吃一辈子。“我是执棋者，这一世，我要赢。”苏沐雪整理了一下裙摆，对着手机黑屏调整了一下表情。清冷，疏离，但又不失礼貌。她抬起手，敲响了面前这扇掉漆严重的防盗门。
content_en: The silly smile on Xia Wanqing's face froze.Her eyes widened, her hands suddenly crossed in front of her chest, and she shrank into the corner of the sofa.Looking at Ye Lin, she looked like she was looking at a pervert who had just escaped from prison. "Old...Old Ye?" She swallowed, her throat tight: "What aroused you?" "I just rejected that big-breasted school beauty... Could it be because you fell in love with my beauty?!" "We are brothers!" "Brothers are brothers, and brothers can't do such things!!" Ye Lin didn't even raise his eyelids, and his eyes swept over the area as flat as an airport under the loose T-shirt.Then, he made a very insulting nasal sound."Ha." It's not very harmful, but it's very insulting.Ye Lin shook the essential oil bottle in his hand, with a look of disgust on his face: "I want to give you a massage." "With your washboard figure, I'm afraid of shaking my hands." "Massage?" Xia Wanqing was stunned for a moment, and then her hair broke out."Ye Lin, you uncle! Who are you talking about the washboard!" "I'm pretty good at it too! It's pressed by a sports bra! Do you know how to press it?" "If you don't believe me, try it!" "Okay, it's good, it's pressed to the Mariana Trench." Ye Lin pointed to the single bed."You don't have big breasts like mine, so don't worry about it. Just lie down." Xia Wanqing cursed and moved over, muttering, "If I hadn't seen you fall in love, I would have punched you twice," but she lay down on the bed honestly."Is it really massage?" She turned back to confirm uneasily."What else? You didn't pay me the extra fee." Ye Lin said no more nonsense and unscrewed the bottle cap.The rich rose fragrance explodes instantly, not cloying, but with a chill like the morning sun.He poured a little pink liquid into his palm and warmed it with his body temperature."Old Ye, please be gentle, I'm ticklish..." "I know, it's not itchy." Before she finished speaking, Ye Lin's palm clasped her latissimus dorsi muscle without warning."Ouch——!!!" A miserable howl almost shook the floor.Ye Lin's thumbs were like precision hydraulic pliers, accurately cutting into the gap between the shoulder blades.There was no foreplay at all. Every time he exerted force, he accurately crushed the adhesions in the deep muscles."It hurts! It's broken! The bone is about to break!" Xia Wanqing was so painful that she wanted to perform a carp thrust.But the hands on her back were as heavy as mountains, nailing her to the bed board.One thousand of all attributes versus one point of all attributes is a dimensionality reduction blow."Shut up, don't move." Ye Lin's face was expressionless, and his hands kept moving.In his eyes, what he held under his hand was not a childhood sweetheart, or even a woman, but a piece of jade waiting to be processed.The moment the bottle of [Morning Rose] touched the skin, it showed the dominance of a divine creation.The oil that was originally just light pink, when it came into contact with Xia Wanqing's healthy wheat-colored skin, was like water seeping into a dry sponge, and it "slicked" right into it.The feel has changed.A second ago it had the roughness and stiffness of mortal flesh.The next second, the skin is like kneading a piece of fermenting dough. The more you knead it, the tougher and smoother it becomes.It's a pity that Xia Wanqing's wheat-colored skin has not become whiter at all."I can't do it anymore... Ye Lin, your uncle... you are committing murder..." Xia Wanqing's voice was filled with tears, and she twisted like a maggot on the bed.Ye Lin turned a deaf ear, pressed the heel of his palm against the bladder meridian on both sides of the spine, and pushed hard.Click - a crisp sound of bone resetting."Ah-huh..." Xia Wanqing's scream stopped abruptly, and was replaced by a trembling sigh of relief.After the pain reached its peak, a scalding heat flowed wildly along her spine, making her scalp numb with pleasure."Don't scream, save your strength to absorb it." Ye Lin calculated quickly in his mind.The effect of this essential oil is even more outrageous than expected.With just a few pushes, the muscle lines on Xia Wanqing's back began to fine-tune.The trapezius muscles that were originally strained due to long-term delivery of food and part-time jobs have become tighter and stronger.Even... Ye Lin glanced at the side of her face that was pressed under the pillow, and then glanced down.Although he couldn't see clearly when lying on his stomach, he was keenly aware that this girl's bust seemed... longer?Divine nourishment is an all-around optimization, and even that pitiful bit of fat is going where it should go."Old Ye..." Xia Wanqing calmed down and lay on the pillow like a dead dog, her voice soft."Where did you learn this technique?" Ye Lin ignored her and pressed her thumb on her waist."Hiss—" Xia Wanqing took a breath of cold air.In order to divert his attention, he started to find something to say: "Well... don't say anything." "Although that woman Qin Feifei is indeed not a thing, we are not bad either." "Look at you, you are handsome, and you can... you can also take a bath. I will definitely find someone better in the future." Ye Lin rolled his eyes in his heart as he circled the Mingmen point with his fingers steadily.Is this girl's head full of mush?He was silent because he was concentrating on channeling the power of the medicine.Every drop of this essential oil is priceless. If it is wasted, he will really feel so distressed that he can't breathe.Seeing that Ye Lin didn't speak, Xia Wanqing became anxious. She tried her best to pull her head out of the pillow and looked at him sideways: "Oh, don't be so bored! How about we talk about that statue?" "To be honest, when that big iron block came down today, I felt like my head was buzzing and noisy."Dead."Ye Lin paused and then returned to normal, pressing his elbow on the outside of her thigh: "Yes, it's the angry guy in the city center.""I can hear him shouting from a distance.""What are you shouting for?" Ye Lin asked calmly.His palms moved downward against Xia Wanqing's thigh muscles, pushing away the accumulated lactic acid."Can't hear you clearly... Anyway, he's very irritable and keeps cursing." "Things like 'damn pretty boy', 'don't let me catch you', 'I'm going to beat you to a pulp' and so on." Ye Lin's eyelids twitched.Good guy, is this Hephaestus' spiritual broadcast?It doesn't look fake.Being able to receive it from such a distance seems to be a manifestation of some kind of talent?"Then what? What didn't He give you?" Ye Lin put more effort into his hands."Ah! It hurts! Be gentle!" Xia Wanqing grinned in pain."Didn't it say in the news that if you want to gain power, you have to call the god's [real name] and [deeds]." "But who knows the name of that lame big guy?" "He is so ugly, with one long and one short leg, and a hammer in his hand. Could it be that he is the god of decoration?" "Anyway, he was awakened by foreigners, and it will probably take some time for him to reach us." Ye Lin almost stopped laughing.If the blacksmith heard it, he would probably be so angry that he would refine Blue Star on the spot."There's a lot of noise on the Internet now." Xia Wanqing lay there and let herself be manipulated, but she didn't stop talking."Experts say that our mythology seems to be broken, as well as the Hengshui Kingdom and the Mayan Kingdom." "Everyone knows that there are gods, but there are no records of their specific names and what they have done." "On the contrary, there seem to be sporadic records of the messy gods abroad." "This is not fair, Lao Ye!" She was a little indignant."Why do we have to be dogs for foreign gods?" "I don't believe there is no god in China who is more powerful than that decorator!" "How to measure divine affinity?" Ye Lin suddenly asked a key question.Since Xia Wanqing can sense the statue, it means that the official or private people should have preliminary detection methods."I don't know." "That Qin Feifei is probably an internal test conducted by those rich people." When she said this, she suddenly remembered something and her voice became excited: "But Lao Ye, I feel that I am terrifyingly strong now! Really! You are such an essential oil god!" "I feel like there is a fire burning in my body now. When I wanted to turn over just now, I almost crushed your bed board!" Ye Lin glanced down.really.The originally loose sheets had obvious cracks in the part she held in her hand."Don't move." Ye Lin slapped her tight gluteus maximus, "I haven't finished pressing it yet." "Oh..." Xia Wanqing instantly became honest, her face buried in the pillow, her ears turned red.This slap... was a bit smooth.The air fell into silence again, except for the rustling sound of Ye Lin's fingers rubbing against the skin.This silence made Xia Wanqing even more panicked. She felt that Ye Lin was forcing a smile.Even though he was dumped, he still pretended to give himself a massage as if nothing had happened, and even took out such a precious essential oil... This essential oil was not cheap at first glance, and the effect was so good, he must have spent all his savings on it.Too bad.No money, no job, no girlfriend, and now even the last bit of wealth is for myself.Xia Wanqing was overflowing with motherly love.As a good brother who has protected him since he was young, if he doesn't give him a hand at this time, am he still considered a human being?"That...Old Ye." Xia Wanqing's voice came out muffledly from the pillow."Huh?" Ye Lin was dealing with the meridians on her calf. The muscle lines here had become extremely perfect, slender and tight."You... don't have money to pay the rent now?" Ye Lin paused.money?He had 30,000 yuan in cash in his pocket, which was more than enough to pay the rent.Before he could speak, Xia Wanqing continued on her own: "We know each other very well. Who doesn't know who?" "Although my house is a bit small, it still has two bedrooms and one living room." "The old lady of the landlord likes me very much, and the rent hasn't increased." "How about... you move in with me?" Ye Lin was stunned.Sharing?"Don't think too much!"
